declared_build_goals:
The campaign followed the actual development order (516 commits, oldest to newest):
1. Foundation: monorepo consolidation, 0G compute streaming + wallet-signed sessions, Railway/Vercel deploy, motion/UX polish, IA simplification.
2. Production hardening waves 1-7: auth guards, TEE signature verification, prod auth allowlist, dead-code elimination, security gap fixes, brand identity.
3. Deep audits: 43-finding perf/security audit, 7-agent 0G deep-dive, ERC-7857 spec alignment (nonce, events, signatures), tx-merge research (34 to 31 on-chain txs).
4. Contracts V2: TimelockManager, UUPS conversion of all three upgradeable contracts, bytecode under the 24KB EIP-170 limit, ABI auto-generation, indexer merged into backend, WS broadcast wired to EventStore.
5. Optimization campaigns: 10-cycle dead-code/clone/allocation reduction, full bun-native migration, OZ 5.6.1 + solc upgrades, 2.27x faster forge builds, warning convergence to zero.
6. UX + protocol: chat UX overhaul (P0-P3), transfer co-sign completion, i18n contract, CSS audit (11 phases), live Galileo e2e green, storage transcript persistence, 0G adoption items (RPC fallbacks, storage canary, DEK custody, keeper module).
7. V3 contract campaign (this submission's wave): security fixes, Permit2 settlement, DelegationRegistry, full deploy, statefold, GasTank gasless UX, DeFi rails, mainnet prep, canonical digest fix, sponsored DeFi chat tools.
product_category_justification: The agent itself is the product (ERC-7857 iNFT with gasless chat tools), the swap/lend treasury is the DeFi surface, and the GasTank/relayer is 0G infrastructure any other builder can adopt — all three are live, so the pick costs nothing in honesty.
updates_in_this_wave:
Axiom Protocol is production-built on 0G from day one: an ERC-7857 agent marketplace where a wallet with zero gas pays agents, swaps, borrows, and delegates — every step verified by an on-chain end-to-end run.

Built across 516 commits, in development order:
- Foundation: Bun-native monorepo (backend, frontend, contracts, chat-runtime, config) — 2.5x faster builds, zero-clone audits, single-source env/config, CI drift gates.
- ERC-7857 suite: AgentNFT with TEE-signed transfer proofs and sealed-DEK re-keying; UUPS proxies; TeeVerifier with signer allowlist and immediate revoke; 10-minute TimelockManager on fees/upgrades.
- AxiomGasTank: lazy 0.01 OG grants, per-user nonces, ERC-1271 dual-path signing, reimbursement clamped three ways, solvency fuzz-verified over 257 runs.
- ERC-2771 retrofit + relayer (EIP-712 recovery, eth_call simulation, rate gating, dead-lettering); swap pool, LP shares, lending inside the PaymentProcessor — DeFi rails, zero extra contracts.
- Sponsored chat tools: pay, withdraw, swap_tokens, borrow run gas-free behind a server-side calldata gate; canonical EIP-712 digest hardening (browser E2E caught live drift, fixed, parity verified on-chain).
- 0G depth: Storage Turbo (encrypted payloads, transcripts, sealed-DEK custody), Compute router (wallet-signed sessions), Multicall3, Pyth, honest DA evaluation (ADR-002).

Evidence: 907 tests green (forge 343/0, backend 249, chat 100, config 62, frontend 153). LIVE on 0G Aristotle mainnet (16661): AgentNFT 0xA7DC2A0F1329149BD9643b0fe0677a686eb0d8F2, Vault 0x9dD615F93e3ae7FfDC69D47DC4bBF4027D28616C, Processor 0x9C9DB66AbDA3adb7C83480Ccb8729f94215ac6c2, TeeVerifier 0x1424874A80D92D30A7d85AD8Ce9Bb370f35efD43, DelegationRegistry 0xAB1E333C498cd739120cEA9b44c71bea1f4891Fe, GasTank 0x156D05Ea7D47Da0a264C43855240c91F8eA8c4B6. Deployed via gated DeployAristotle.s.sol (7 safety gates passed); paymentToken W0G 0x1Cd0690fF9a693f5EF2dD976660a8dAFc81A109c, swap pair the WrappedOG precompile, forwarder GasTank, grants off.

Mainnet endurance run (fresh wallet, 0.09 OG): 5 deposits, 10 gasless relays attempted — 8 landed (nonce 0→8), accounting exact to the wei, grantsUsed 0.

What failed, what didn't: 2/10 relays failed — transient RPC connection-reset, retried OK. The first relay hit InvalidUserSignature from a hand-computed digest; signing the contract's forwardRequestDigest() view fixed it — the exact drift-guard W8 mandated, now proven on mainnet. No contract-level failures. App: https://axiom-protocol-nine.vercel.app · Code: https://github.com/symulacr/axiom-protocol
fourth_wave_milestone: DONE this wave: DeployAristotle.s.sol executed on Aristotle mainnet (16661) — all seven instances deployed and wired behind the 7 pre-broadcast safety gates, addresses saved to env + deployment record. Proven live by a 10-relay endurance run: fresh wallet, 5 deposits, 8/10 relays landed with exact tank accounting — the gasless journey (grant-or-deposit, digest sign, relay) works on mainnet, not just testnet. Next milestone: a judge repeating that journey at the demo URL.
fifth_wave:
1. Public replay. Fund the relayer to >=0.5 OG (~800 sponsored ops) and record one replayable mainnet session: fresh wallet deposits, sponsored swap + borrow, every op carrying a Relayed tx hash.
2. Relayer durability. Persist the sponsorship queue behind the EventStore; deadline-bounded signatures already allow re-submission.
3. Relayer hardening from the endurance run: automatic RPC-failover retry so a connection-reset never costs an op; relayer digest fetching from forwardRequestDigest() as the only signing path.
4. Lending v2. External Pyth price for LP collateral valuation, interest accrual, liquidation path.
5. Ops: off-chain alarm on swapSolvency() so pool solvency is monitored continuously.
6. UI/UX + sandbox wave: full UI/UX pass, then a sandbox (Novita.ai GPU) where a user runs their own agent (Hermes model, OpenClaw browser automation) against the live mainnet contracts, paying gas-free from its tank.
